Package dev.relism.flash.routing

Class Router

java.lang.Object
dev.relism.flash.routing.Router
public final class Router extends Object
Every route of one app in a single byte-level state machine, and the one path a request takes through it, whichever protocol carried it.

Matching runs over the method token, as it arrived, followed by the path bytes. A WebSocket route lives under a method of its own, WS, so a path can serve a page and a socket at once, and its middleware runs before the handshake like any other route's. A route for every method lives under *, which matches any token; a route under a method of its own wins over it. A path that ends in /** names what that matched **. Built by the app when the server starts; nothing is added afterwards.

    • dispatch

      public Response dispatch(Exchange exchange, Router.Scratch scratch) throws Exception
      Runs request through its route and returns the response to send. A response written as it goes has been written by then.

      A HEAD with no route of its own is served by the GET route (the writer drops the body), also when a route for every method covers the path; a path that exists under other methods is a 405 naming them.
